test_agreement.compared: mlp versus trees_uncalibrated, absolute difference in win probability

spread_at_kickoff.description: Opening kickoff, receiving team at home, half-point steps

yardline_at_half.description: First and 10 (or goal), tied, even spread, second-half start

score_with_5_min.description: First and 10 at own 25, 5:00 left, even spread

spread.unit: standard deviation of win probability across members (0.01 = 1 point)
notes: seeds: same training games, seed + i. bagged: games resampled with replacement and seed + i. fixed_seed: the same resamples as bagged, every member with the base seed.
The early-stopping seasons are not resampled in any of the three.

trees_bootstrap: the tree model refitted on resampled training games, with its Platt map refitted on resampled calibration games. trees_bootstrap_no_platt: the same refits without the map, which is the like-for-like comparison with the MLP bootstrap, where the 2022 to 2023 seasons are not resampled.
The states are a seeded random sample of the evaluated test-season plays. Only their game states are used here, never their outcomes.

tuning.note: No calibration map. Calibration and test seasons are not used here. log_loss_after_platt applies a Platt map fitted on the early-stopping games.
tuning.adoption_rule: A variant replaces the starting point of its round only if its worst seed has a lower validation log loss than the starting point's best seed.

notes: Every model is scored on the same rows as results/m1_wp_metrics.json.
a_minus_b entries are game-level bootstrap differences with 95% intervals; negative means a is better.
mlp is one network (the base seed), early stopped on the calibration seasons, with no calibration map. mlp_platt adds a Platt map fitted on those same seasons.
mlp_ensemble is the mean of the first k seed-only members; mlp_bagged is the mean of the first k game-bootstrap members.
ece uses equal-width bins of the prediction (count in metrics.ece_bins).
